description: Enterprise CRM and application platform for sales, service, and custom business apps.
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 (web server, user-agent, JWT bearer, and client-credentials flows) via a Connected App / External Client App. Session ID also usable for SOAP.
rate_limits: Per-org daily API request limits based on edition/licenses.
main_blocker: Connected App / OAuth setup complexity; production value tied to customer orgs

evidence.snippet: REST API provides a powerful, convenient, and simple Web services API for interacting with Lightning Platform.
Free Developer Edition org with full API access for building and testing.
Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers use the Model Context Protocol to turn on secure agentic interoperability.

notes: Developer Edition is free and self-serve, so credentials are obtainable; however real-world deployments target paid customer orgs. Hosted MCP Servers reached GA in 2026.

description: Team messaging and collaboration platform with an extensive app/bot platform.
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 issuing bot and user tokens (xoxb/xoxp) used as Bearer tokens against the Web API.
main_blocker: Workspace admin may need to approve app installation

evidence.snippet: Slack apps use OAuth 2.0 to obtain access tokens (bot and user tokens).
The Web API exposes 200+ HTTP methods for interacting with Slack.
Model Context Protocol server giving AI agents a secure way to use Slack.

notes: Free to create apps; installation into a workspace may require admin approval depending on workspace settings.

description: Amazon's API for sellers to manage listings, orders, fulfillment, finances, and reports.
auth_detail: Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth 2.0; historically also AWS SigV4, now largely removed. Requires registered SP-API application.
main_blocker: Developer registration + Amazon approval and a Professional selling account required

evidence.snippet: You must register as a Selling Partner API developer before registering your SP-API application; access is granted based on your developer profile.
In Seller Central you must have a professional selling account to develop SP-API applications; individual accounts are not eligible.
SP-API uses Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth 2.0 access tokens over REST.

notes: API is broad and public but access is gated behind developer registration, Amazon approval, role approval, and a paid Professional selling account.

description: SEO toolset providing backlink, keyword, rank-tracking, and site-audit data.
auth_detail: API v3 uses an API key as a Bearer token; Ahrefs Connect adds OAuth 2.0 for user-authorized apps.
rate_limits: Unit-based consumption; minimum 50 units per request.
main_blocker: API v3 access is tied to the Enterprise plan (paid/enterprise gating)

evidence.snippet: API v3 access is available to Enterprise plan users; enterprise users automatically receive API v3 access.
You'll need an API key to send requests via Ahrefs API v3. Provide it as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.
Ahrefs MCP lets AI agents securely access the Ahrefs API and enrich answers with real Ahrefs data.

notes: Classic API-exists-but-access-gated case: a documented REST API and a first-party MCP exist, but credentials require the paid Enterprise plan.

description: Open-source command-line OSINT tool that hunts usernames across social networks.
auth_detail: No API keys or login credentials required; it constructs expected profile URLs and inspects HTTP responses. Runs locally.
main_blocker: Product is a local CLI/library, not a hosted callable API

evidence.snippet: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks (command-line tool).
It does not require API keys or login credentials for the sites it checks; it constructs the expected profile URL and observes the response.

notes: Trap app: not a hosted SaaS API. Could be wrapped as a tool by shelling out, but it is not an agent-callable hosted API in the Composio toolkit sense.

description: Developer platform for hosting Git repositories, code review, issues, and CI/CD.
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 (OAuth apps), fine-grained/classic Personal Access Tokens, and GitHub App installation tokens (JWT-signed).

evidence.snippet: GitHub's REST API covers repositories, issues, pulls, actions, and more.
OAuth apps and personal access tokens can be created self-serve for free.
GitHub's official MCP Server; a remote server is hosted by GitHub.

notes: Both REST and GraphQL, official remote MCP; strong easy-win.

description: Payments platform and APIs for online businesses (charges, subscriptions, payouts).
auth_detail: Secret/restricted API keys sent as Bearer; OAuth 2.0 for Stripe Connect platforms.
rate_limits: ~100 read / 100 write req/s in live mode (default).
main_blocker: None (business activation needed for live charges, but test mode is immediate)

evidence.snippet: The Stripe API is organized around REST; authenticate with API keys as Bearer tokens.
Sign up and immediately get test-mode API keys for free.
The Stripe MCP server provides tools AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API; a remote server is hosted at mcp.stripe.com.

notes: Best-in-class self-serve developer experience; official remote MCP over OAuth.

description: Command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG/PNG/PDF.
auth_detail: No authentication; installed via npm (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) and run locally, using headless Chromium to render.
main_blocker: Product is a local CLI/library, not a hosted callable API

evidence.snippet: This is a command-line interface (mmdc) for mermaid. It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an svg/png/pdf file.

notes: Trap app: an npm package/CLI, not a hosted API. Community MCP servers for Mermaid rendering exist but are not part of this CLI project.

description: Third-party managed REST API (TranscriptAPI) for extracting YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists.
auth_detail: API key authentication; free tier grants 100 credits, paid plans from ~$5/mo.
rate_limits: Credit/plan based (e.g. 1K credits on entry plan).
main_blocker: None (third-party dependency and ToS risk relative to YouTube)

evidence.snippet: The YouTube Transcript API provides a simple REST way to extract transcripts; covers authentication, request parameters, and response formats.
Get transcripts, search videos, browse channels, and extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP.
A TranscriptAPI account free tier gives you 100 credits to follow along.

notes: Correctly researched as the supplied vendor (transcriptapi.com / TranscriptAPI), NOT YouTube's official API. It is a self-serve third-party wrapper with its own key and MCP.
